svg.text: A CUBE BY HAND (THE SCULPTURE'S WORD, ? LAST): THE DIGITS OF EASTNORT
Write the three digits of each letter in a
column under it, as here. For a block of
letters, read the digits across row by row,
regroup them in threes and look each three up
Working backwards from the carved letters,
every known letter fixes which cube cell its
digits point to; a cube must agree with all of
